# PRES2028: Citizen (If We Were President)

> Free browser-based incremental strategy game where players grow a party-less citizen campaign from one door knock to 270 electoral votes.

## Pages

- [Play](https://ifwewerepresident.com/): Main interactive campaign strategy game.
- [Guide](https://ifwewerepresident.com/guide/): How the game mechanics and electoral map work.
